main_idea: Warmup lifts GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7, near the teacher's 49.5
ideas: Warmup raises GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7
Warmup leaves Ultra 2.8 points behind teacher
Throughput is about 6x comparable open models
summary: The bar chart carries the result cleanly, but three stat cards, an eyebrow, a repeated headline word, a footer wordmark and a wordy footer sentence clutter it; nothing essential is missing.
defects: Stat card text overflows the card bottom in cards two and three
49.5 label sits on top of the teacher's dashed outline
Dashed connector line runs under the 35.3 label
